posts.message:
A little kindness made a big difference today. 💚

I was at the post office with a dead battery and jumper cables hanging out from under the hood when Jesse and his family stopped and offered to give me a jump.

They took time out of their day to help someone who needed it, and we’re incredibly thankful.

At Roswell Family Farm, looking out for our neighbors means a lot to us. Jesse and his family showed that same care for their community today, and we wanted to return the kindness.

We’re putting together an early Thanksgiving package for their family as a thank-you from ours. It’s a small way to show how much we appreciate them stopping to help.

Jesse, thank you to you and your family. You made a frustrating day a whole lot better. 🦃💚

— AJ & Emily
Roswell Family Farm
